source: Ms. Whitby's Playground — original Python lessons aligned with ThinkCSPy concepts

lessons.title: Repeat until a stop signal
lessons.summary: A `while` loop repeats until a condition changes, making it useful when the stopping point is part of the input.
hints: Begin an index or counter at zero.
While the index is in bounds and the current value is not `'stop'`, move forward.
Return the number of events visited.

lessons.title: Break a problem into helper functions
lessons.summary: Small functions can each handle one responsibility and work together to solve a larger task.
hints: Only add a score when it is greater than zero.
Return the total plus the bonus after the loop.

lessons.title: Find the first matching position
lessons.summary: A linear search visits items in order and stops once it finds the first matching value.
hints: Return the index as soon as the value matches.
Return -1 after checking every item without a match.

lessons.title: Build a data-informed event report
lessons.summary: Turn raw event records into a consistent, readable summary using several Python skills together.
hints: Build a dictionary of counts using `.get()`.
Create strings `name + ':' + str(count)` and join them using `' | '`.
